# jamfplatform_security_cloud_uem_connect (List Resource)

Finds the Jamf Security Cloud UEM Connect integration on the tenant, for generating an import block with `terraform query`. A tenant holds at most one, so there is nothing to filter and this takes no configuration.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `uem-connect:read` |
